standard: VN academic research protocol (config.json, FORMAT_CONFIG_GUIDE.md worked example)

checks.description: headings.1 specifies bold + center; both are applied as direct formatting on top of Heading1.
headings.1's align: center produces a <w:jc val="center"/> paragraph override.
headings.3 specifies align: justify, applied as a direct paragraph override.
A paragraph tagged attrs.role='reference' resolves via the top-level `reference` block to the Bibliography style.
Vietnamese diacritics survive normalization and rendering unescaped.
